question: What is the meaning of component joints in relation to geometric information?
description: Component joints refer to the connections between different components of a building, such as walls, floors, and ceilings. They provide geometric information about the spatial relationships between these components, enabling accurate modeling and analysis in building information modeling (BIM) systems. This information is crucial for understanding the structural integrity and performance of the building.
